event.distribution_pattern: Product was distributed to IA, IL, MO, KS, NE, SD, MN, and WI. There was no foreign/government/military distribution.

products.product_description: Whole wheels and cuts of Maytag blue cheese re-packaged in foil or clear plastic wrap with scale labels in various weights. Product was labeled as Maytag Blue Raw Milk, Maytag Blue, or Maytag Iowa Blue Cheese with PLU numbers beginning with 854089001.
products.code_info: Use by dates: Jan. 20, 2016 through May 3, 2016.
products.reason_for_recall: Product may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
